Project Overview

Green Charm is a natural beauty and cosmetics brand developed from the ground up, with a focus on creating a refined and feminine brand identity inspired by nature and natural beauty.

The project involved developing a complete visual identity system that translates the brand's intended positioning into a cohesive visual language, combining natural elements, elegant aesthetics, and a premium brand presence.

Industry Beauty & Cosmetics
Project Scope Complete Visual Identity & Social Media Design
Target Audience Women interested in natural beauty and skincare
Brand Positioning Luxury Natural Beauty
Deliverables Logo System, Visual Identity, Brand Assets, Social Media Designs
02 / 09

The Challenge

Building a Distinctive Natural Beauty Identity

Starting from Scratch

The challenge was to establish a distinctive visual identity for a new beauty brand starting from scratch.

Elegant & Feminine Character

The identity needed to communicate natural beauty while maintaining an elegant, feminine, and premium character.

Consistent Visual Foundation

It also needed to provide a consistent visual foundation that could extend across the brand's digital communication and proposed physical applications.

03 / 09

Brand Strategy

Brand Positioning: Luxury Natural Beauty — Green Charm follows a premium-oriented visual direction within the natural beauty category, bringing together the purity of nature and the elegance of feminine beauty.

Natural & Elegant

Natural: Inspired by botanical forms and the beauty of nature. Elegant: Refined visual details and balanced compositions.

Feminine & Premium

Feminine: Soft, graceful, and beauty-oriented expression. Premium: A sophisticated visual presence.

Trustworthy

A clear and consistent identity that supports brand recognition.

Purity

Core Value — The purity of natural beauty.

Nature

Core Value — Inspired by botanical forms.

Trust

Core Value — Clear and consistent presence.

Femininity

Core Value — Soft, graceful expression.

04 / 09

Creative Concept

Where Nature Meets Feminine Beauty — The visual concept is built around the relationship between feminine beauty and natural elements.

Art Direction & Symbol
The logo combines the initial letter "C" from the brand name with a feminine facial profile, flowing hair, and botanical details.

These elements come together to create a distinctive symbol that connects the brand with beauty, nature, and femininity. The visual direction balances deep botanical greens, turquoise accents, natural tones, and refined gold details to establish a premium beauty aesthetic. The overall approach emphasizes organic inspiration, elegant presentation, and a recognizable visual identity.

05 / 09

Logo Development

From Initial Letter to Brand Symbol — The logo development explored how the initial letter "C" could become a recognizable visual symbol rather than a simple typographic element.

The structural foundation of the symbol.

Visual Identity System

A Cohesive Visual Language — The visual identity extends the logo concept into a consistent system of colors, typography, graphic elements, and supporting visual assets.

Color Palette

A nature-inspired palette combining deep green, turquoise, fresh green, and soft neutral tones, complemented by warm gold accents.

Typography, Graphic Elements & Logo System

A coordinated Arabic and English typography direction designed to support readability and maintain the brand's elegant personality. Botanical illustrations, organic patterns, leaves, and natural textures reinforce the brand's connection to nature, alongside primary/secondary logos, standalone mark, monochrome variations, and usage principles.

08 / 09

Social Media Design

Extending the Identity into Digital Communication — Social media design was included in the actual project scope.

Digital Communication

Created & Published Branded Content

A series of branded content designs was created and published, extending the visual identity into the brand's digital communication. The designs maintain the brand's visual language through consistent colors, typography, product presentation, and botanical-inspired elements.

09 / 09

Final Brand Experience

A Unified Expression of Natural Beauty — The final identity brings together a distinctive logo, a nature-inspired color system, coordinated typography, and supporting graphic elements.

The approved visual identity provides Green Charm with a cohesive foundation for brand recognition and visual communication. Alongside the published social media designs, conceptual brand applications demonstrate how the identity can extend beyond digital platforms into packaging, stationery, and retail environments.
